intro: Football and the traditional games chinlone and lethwei are Myanmar's most popular sports.

chapters.title: Chinlone and lethwei
text: In chinlone, players keep a cane ball in the air with their feet, more like dance than competition. Lethwei, Burmese boxing, allows head butts.

chapters.title: Football
text: Burma won football gold at the Asian Games in 1966 and 1970.

keyTerms.meaning: A team game of keeping a cane ball in the air.
